name: Threadline public design DNA
supersedes: 2.0.0 (the restraint pass of the afternoon of 2026-09-09: schematic line drawings, unchanged section order). 1.0.0 was the illustrated sticker system of the morning (docs/design/VISUAL_DIAGNOSIS_2026-09-09.md).
authority: This file and docs/design/THREADLINE_PUBLIC_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md (v3) are the design source of truth for the public site. reference-analysis/ (Birdhouse, Hydra, Starborn, LeverBrands, Invisible Keyboard, Windmill, Demandii, Influent, Nova Impact, Understory) is analysed input; the frozen clones under reference-analysis/clones are skeletons, never shipped.

concept.world: The Threadline Authority Factory — raw expertise enters as a spool of thread; stations along one line transform it; packages leave for the market; the market's answer travels back along the thread; the next batch is better informed.
concept.rendering: a tangible system: filled 2.5D objects (chips, cards, tokens, tiles, markers, chambers, modules) on soft paths — not a cartoon, not a line diagram
concept.thread: the idea lineage (accent 2px for the trunk, ink 1.5px for branches, soft hairline for guides)
concept.character: Founder figure once on the home page (founder burden); Buyer avatars as objects; twice in the playbook

intensities.public: editorial, calm with a few expressive moments, motion that teaches

concept.categoryRule: Threadline is a managed authority + qualified-demand system; the platform is a component, not the category — no platform is named in a headline
homepageOrder: 04 founder burden (four ember tiles vs the Threadline board)
05 Authority Factory (seven chambers, travelling idea card)

roles.sunkBand: canvasDeep (three sections on the home page, never alternating)
roles.border: line on quiet cards, lineStrong on cards and section rules; never thicker than 1px
roles.eyebrow: inkFaint (accentDeep at most once per section)
roles.highlight: stampSoft behind the H1 phrase; stamp for the eyebrow inside dark cards

colours.shadows: none on public surfaces; shared --shadow-* tokens remap to none / hairline / very soft ambient

buttons.secondary: paper fill, ink border, inverts on hover

shape.chips: quiet — canvasDeep fill, no border, 28px; used sparingly
shape.stamps: 1px current-colour outline, never rotated, one per moment

illustration.status: kept for How it works (nine-station line, gates, proof chain) and the playbook; retired from the homepage in favour of the object language

motion.principle: motion with a job; every animation has a reduced-motion still
motion.returnPulse: SVG animateMotion 2.6s loop in viewBox units (scales; no overflow)
motion.reveal: IntersectionObserver Reveal (data-shown), one per block; route steps and CTA outputs stagger
motion.heroMachine: objects enter once, 700ms each, staggered 0.2s → 7s (tl-mc-in); at rest afterwards
motion.factory: one rAF-throttled scroll listener moves the idea card along a container-query track (transform only); the active chamber lifts; press holds a chamber
motion.multiply: one root card → five tiles, 350ms, transform + opacity
motion.progression: scroll progress → CSS variable; dots fade, validated lines thicken
motion.reducedMotion: the reduced-motion block in public-v3.css stops every keyframe and transition; the factory disarms its scroll link; qa:public verifies zero running animations

heroPanel.art: absolute right from 1200; centred under the text (max 880) below; panel min-height 680 at ≥1200

breakpoints.640: pill buttons stop wrapping; factory rail 2-up; buyer-pool cards return to the stage; comparison type grows
breakpoints.992: hero machine leaves the grid stack for the placed scene
breakpoints.1024: buyer pool and labour split side by side; factory 4-up
breakpoints.1200: hero side-by-side (machine 52% right); below it the machine stacks under the statement

claims.publicPricing: never disclosed (DEC-017); npm run qa:public fails on any price string
claims.illustrativeLabels: every synthetic thesis, score, number and asset on the page carries a visible 'illustrative' label (claims ledger C-THESIS-ILLUSTRATIVE, C-LEARNING-ILLUSTRATIVE, C-SYNTHETIC-NUMBERS)
claims.comparison: capability wording only — core / built in / when useful / first class vs typically / sometimes / rarely / depends / no; never a measured comparison, never a price row (C-COMPARISON)

objects.file: src/components/factory/objects.tsx (+ the Objects block at the end of src/app/public.css; section systems in src/app/public-v3.css)

depth.edge: --edge: 3px bottom edge in a darker paper tone

primitives.Obj: base surface with tone (paper / ember / signal / stamp / ink / canvas)
primitives.Token: a pill for a thing that moves (Your expertise)
primitives.SignalChip: a small mono chip for a market signal
primitives.ThesisCard: paper card with a coloured header band and placeholder lines
primitives.ContentTile: native content tiles: linkedin, video, x, threads, carousel, newsletter, post — each visibly different
primitives.ResponseMarker: reply / profile / enquiry / call markers in signal or stamp tones
primitives.ScoreCard: a card with a big numeral (route board, learning loop)
primitives.Chamber: a factory station: label tab, index, body; button when pressable
primitives.ModuleTile / OutputTile: labelled tiles for the Threadline board and the CTA outputs

rules: one focal object cluster per section
tones: paper by default; ember for the founder and the thesis; signal for the market's answer; stamp for the commercial event; ink for one dark module
labels 10–11px mono inside objects, never smaller
